entities.name: Alfredo Dugès
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alfredo Dugès was a French-born, Mexican physician and naturalist born in Montpellier. He was the son of zoologist Antoine Louis Dugès (1797–1838). Alfredo Dugès is largely remembered for his extensive studies of Mexican herpetology.
